name: v8.6.0
body:
Contained in this release is updates to linear solver to enable running on GPUs, a new pressure-based incompressible solver, support for multi-zone adjoint for turbomachinery, detailed chemistry solver coupled with Cantera, improved multigrid and improvements to the scalar solver.

## What's Changed
### :rocket: Experimental Features
* Allow FSI+CHT (aerothermoelasticity) by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2807
* Efficiency improvements for optimization of linear elasticity problems by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2815
* Option to compile everything in single precision + explicit vectorization for ARM by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2819
* Discrete adjoint multi-zone for python wrapper by @EvertBunschoten in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2787
* Detect non-physical solutions in a statistic way instead of just P or T <= 0 by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2830
* Store matrices in LDU format to improve performance of LU-SGS and ILU preconditioners by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2838
* SU2 Binary grid format by @vdweide in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2535
* BOUNDED_SCALAR convective scheme compatible with compressible flow by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2844
* Add support for Riemann boundary condition to all scalar solvers by @aureliegrebe in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2846
* Quantization of the Jacobian matrix to speed up linear algebra operations by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2836
* Add initial end-to-end CUDA FGMRES solver path by @LwhJesse in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2825
* Port ILU to GPU by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2858
* [GSoC] Feature: MultiDot  with cublas<t>gemm (Originally: Jacobi preconditioner on GPU and CUDA Unified preconditiong matrix) by @ddg93 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2843
* Quantized versions of Jacobi and Identity preconditioners by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2869
* Multizone adjoints for turbomachinery by @joshkellyjak in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2446
* Improved Trapezoidal Mapping for FGM - Update by @tkiymaz in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2845
* Full Multi-Grid improvements by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2873
* [GSoC] Feature: LU-SGS preconditioner to GPU by @ddg93 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2872
* Improvements for tape recording debug mode (e.g. zone-specific tags) by @oleburghardt in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2721
* Make CUDA acceleration compatible with discrete adjoint by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2888
* Improved  combustion solver robustness for coarse grids by @EvertBunschoten in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2733
* Change for sliding plane when relative frame is used by @FabianYan2010 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2311
* Pressure Based Solver by @thijsaalbers in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2812
* Add initialization option for incompressible solver by @Cristopher-Morales in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2709
* Fix integer overflows and parallelize the output writers for large meshes by @rois1995 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2924
* Update CI docker images to 261011-1107 by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2971
* Add aeroacoustic pressure spectrum analysis by @tokito-99 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2851
* Adding Cantera fluid model for incompressible reacting flows by @Cristopher-Morales in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2713
### :pill: Bug Fixes
* Reduce redundant CUDA Jacobian uploads during a linear solve by @LwhJesse in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2806
* Replace custom CUDA CSysMatrix matvec with cuSPARSE BSR SpMV by @LwhJesse in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2816
* Fix multigrid early exit functionality by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2831
* Enable viscous flux contribution at supersonic outlet boundary condition by @yiluntam in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2829
* Apply the QCR2000 correction to the turbulent stress only (fix #2738) by @bigboateng in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2855
* Fix MG species restart crash by @aureliegrebe in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2849
* Implementing variable density for unsteady incompressible flow by @tkiymaz in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2641
* Fix segfault parsing marker options whose names start with a digit by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2868
* Fix parsing of Nastran small field reals in the modal structural solver by @binggao1230 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2859
* Fix MUSCL_TURB with convective schemes that do not store density gradients by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2886
* Error on MPI+CUDA, compatibility with Newton-Krylov, fix OpenMP deadlock in Newton-Krylov by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2887
* Make single and double precision restarts compatible with either version of the code by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2889
* Fix ASCII compact restarts by @joshkellyjak in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2891
* Fix periodic comm counts by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2894
* Fix compact restarts for surface_csv  by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2892
* Fix broken append and var_names paths in SU2.io.data by @pragyaangaur in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2867
* Consistent NEMO viscous Jacobian: distinct left block and subtractive edge assembly by @bellonarts in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2885
* Pass the edge length, not its square, to the coarse NEMO viscous Jacobian by @bellonarts in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2883
* Make the NEMO total-energy under-relaxation check reachable by @bellonarts in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2884
* Multigrid with 3D implicit line agglomeration by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2863
* Axisymmetric near-axis fixes using L’Hôpital-consistent formulations by @raghava-davuluri in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2715
* Fix NEMO history MAX_/BGS_ residual groups: species-first indexing and finite maximum residuals by @bellonarts in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2882
* Fix the divergence of the SA wall functions by @rois1995 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2957
* Quote the SU2 executable path in SU2_PY on Linux/macOS (SU2_RUN with spaces) by @nikita-ageev in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2935
* Fix the pressure-based solver with variable density, boundary conditions and SIMPLEC by @rois1995 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2958
* Fix LINELET with mpi, add regression case for laminar NACA0012 by @Syphonicc in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2899
* Fixes for rotational periodic boundaries: implicit solver, multigrid and limiters by @rois1995 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2961
* BCGSTAB: return the iterate with the smallest residual by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2933
* Fix the internal energy used by the under-relaxation factor by @rois1995 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2942
* Fix TSan CI build for develop, cantera by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2991
* Fix overwritten axisymmetric Jacobian in the SST source by @Syphonicc in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2986
### :wrench: Maintenance
* Flexible setup of flamelet boundary conditions by @bigfooted in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2814
* Do not compute vorticity when it's not necessary by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2835
* Add OpenMP for force calculation. by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2870
* Fix misleading "All convergence criteria satisfied." message on interrupted runs by @bellonarts in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2881
* Modernize scalar numerics by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2878
### Other Changes
* Compare NEMO freestream mass fractions against a roundoff tolerance by @bellonarts in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2880
* Revert "Fix compact restarts for surface_csv " by @pcarruscag in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2895
* Fix MSVC build error from std::array::begin() passed as raw pointer by @ManasBagul23 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2900
* Fix two output bugs in pysu2_nastran by @ManasBagul23 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2901
* Add missing adjoint suffixes to get_adjointSuffix by @ManasBagul23 in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2909
* Changing version number to 8.6.0 by @joshkellyjak in https://github.com/su2code/SU2/pull/2994
